CRP.notes: Only sour cream powder, coconut cream powder and milk powders found (rejected types). Re-checked 2026-09-17 under the new owner rule (a real spray-dried dairy cream powder outside 38-48 % fat is a valid B_SAME_TYPE_DIFFERENT_COMPOSITION candidate). Still BRAK: no dairy cream powder of any fat level was found on a page that binds to this market. The only genuine retail dairy cream powder found anywhere in this pass is Hoosier Hill Farm "Heavy Cream Powder" (hoosierhillfarm.com, "made with 100% real sweet cream", "72% butterfat content", 1 lb / 2 lb / 25 lb, US) - it is NOT recorded as a candidate because the seller's shipping policy (hoosierhillfarm.com/policies/shipping-policy) prints no destination countries and no international-delivery statement, so there is no verifiable purchase path into this market. Owner may want to ask them directly. Owner rule 3 (B2B stays B2B): the only genuine dairy cream powder route that exists in this region is industrial - Fonterra/NZMP "Cream Powder 55" (blend of fresh dairy cream and skim milk, spray-dried, 55 % fat, quote verified) and regional B2B dairy traders such as bestdairies.com (Klang, Malaysia) in 25 kg sacks. Tagged B2B, not presented as a retail offer and not recorded as a candidate because no purchase page binds it to this market. Retail shelves in the region carry non-dairy creamers, whole/full-cream milk powders and whipped-topping mixes, which the protocol rejects.

YOL.notes: No dried egg yolk powder found. Cross-border route for dried egg yolk was searched and closed 2026-09-17: the one European retailer with a verified 100 % spray-dried chicken egg yolk powder in a 100 g retail pack (pati-versand.de, "Eigelbpulver 100g") ships only to a named list of 20 European countries, and gourmet-versand.com - the one shop whose delivery-country selector does name Asian markets - has no egg powder at all. So there is currently no verifiable purchase path for dried egg yolk into this market. New LEAD 2026-09-17: burket.ph (B2B business marketplace, .ph) lists "FERNA EGG YOLK POWDER" from Ferna Corporation, but with "Contact supplier for price" only - no pack, no price, no composition. Marketplaces never confirm, so LEAD at most, and it is not a retail offer. Local retail searches (love2bake.com.ph product search, Lazada PH) returned nothing usable.
